Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace='''[
  {"step": 1, "file": "src-vul/magic_fuzzer_loaddb.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 18, "var": "data/size", "code": "FuzzerTemporaryFile ftf(data, size);", "note": "The attacker-controlled bytes are written to a temporary file whose path is then passed to libmagic's database loader."},
  {"step": 2, "file": "src-vul/magic_fuzzer_loaddb.cc", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 19, "var": "ftf.filename()", "code": "magic_check(magic, ftf.filename());", "note": "The temporary file is parsed as a magic database, so malformed note records can reach the readelf note parser."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src-vul/file/src/magic.c", "function": "magic_check", "line": 326, "var": "magicfile", "code": "return file_apprentice(ms, magicfile, FILE_CHECK);", "note": "magic_check forwards the file path into the apprentice loader in CHECK mode, which still parses the database contents."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src-vul/file/src/readelf.c", "function": "do_bid_note", "line": 575, "var": "nbuf[doff]", "code": "memcpy(desc, &nbuf[doff], descsz);", "note": "For a GNU build-id note, the parser copies descsz bytes from the note description into a fixed 20-byte stack buffer without bounding descsz to 20, creating the heap-buffer-overflow read when descsz is larger than the available note payload."}
]'''
p.write_text(trace)
print(p.read_text())
PY
